label: diadelphous
definition: A connate quality inhering in an androecium or its stamens by virtue of the stamen filaments being united into two separate groups, often 9 + 1 or 5 + 5.
reason: PATO and FLOPO have no term for stamens joined in two bundles. It is a kind of FLOPO:0991067 connate (like parts fused), limited to the number of groups.
'A liane' names the growth form of a woody climber. The earlier review mapped 'lianescent' to FLOPO climbing; this follows it.

label: hair-pointed
definition: A pointed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ending in a long, slender, hair-like point, often hyaline.
reason: Most uses (leaf apex 'piliferous or muticous', mostly in moss treatments) mean ending in a hair-point. This is a sibling of FLOPO:0991210 spine-tipped. The rarer sense 'bearing hairs' on stems and fruits is just PATO hairy.
Broadly ovate is ovate with a lower length-to-width ratio. It maps to the broader ovate class, as 'prominulous' was mapped to prominent and 'lobulate' to lobed.
Glomerate means gathered into dense clusters (glomerules). PATO aggregated has the exact synonym 'clustered'. FLOPO:0991006 capitate is the narrower term when heads are meant.

label: parasitic
definition: An organismal quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its obtaining water or nutrients, wholly or in part, from another living plant to which it is attached by haustoria.
reason: This is a common habit statement in floras with no PATO term. Like epiphytic (FLOPO:0991110) it is probably outside PATO's scope, so it is kept in FLOPO.
A comparison with a named second part ('shorter than the perigynia'). Pattern 09 maps it to decreased length PATO:0000574 relative to that part.

target: new: intermediate shape (two shape values joined by a hyphen, with a degree modifier)
reason: A compound of two values (ovate, elliptic) plus 'narrowly'. It needs a pattern for a shape between two values, not a term.

Curly hairs ('poils frisés') are crisped hairs. FLOPO crisped already lists trichome as a bearer, but its definition speaks of a margin and should be widened to cover hairs. PATO:0000405 curled is a colony-border quality and does not fit.

label: semi-elliptic
definition: A 2-D shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's outline being half an ellipse, bounded on one side by a straight line along one of the ellipse's axes.
reason: A distinct outline used for indusia, stipules and lemmas. It is a sibling of PATO:0002232 semicircular, and PATO has no half-ellipse.

label: locellate
definition: A structural quality inhering in an anther or anther theca by virtue of its locules being divided by septa into smaller chambers (locelli).
reason: A key anther character (e.g. in Mimosoideae) with no PATO term. PO:0005010 anther septum is the normal partition between locules, so entity presence would not capture it.
A vague count of veins, like 'few-flowered'. It belongs to the count-of-parts pattern with an open count, not to a term.
Lanuginose means woolly, with long, soft, tangled hairs. PATO lanate has the exact synonym 'woolly'.
Pattern 11 names 'wider than long' explicitly as a width-to-length ratio above 1.
Not sheathing is the negation of FLOPO sheathing, as 'unlobed' is not lobed.
A superlative ranking a part within a set. The earlier review rejected 'broadest' on the same grounds.
Helmet-shaped (galeate) lips and perigone lobes are hood-like, the sense of FLOPO cucullate. Seeds and schizocarps described this way fit less well, and galeate could be a related synonym.

label: medifixed
definition: An attachment quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being attached at or near its middle, with free arms or ends on either side of the point of attachment.
reason: Used mainly for T-shaped (malpighian) hairs, and also for anthers. It is a sibling of FLOPO:0991134 dorsifixed and FLOPO:0991135 basifixed. FLOPO versatile is specific to swinging anthers.
'Well defined' veins, teeth and regions are clearly visible and delimited. The earlier review mapped 'distinct', 'evident' and 'obvious' to conspicuous.
Muriculate means minutely muricate. It maps to the broader FLOPO muricate, as 'strigillose' was mapped to strigulose and 'prominulous' to prominent.

label: hygroscopic
definition: A structural quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's changing shape or position, by twisting, bending, spreading or closing, in response to changes in air humidity.
reason: A real character of awns, setae, capsule valves and moss leaves with no PATO term. It is placed under structure as dehiscent (FLOPO:0991149) was.
Abbreviated stems, inflorescences and pinnae are shortened. PATO decreased length has the synonym 'short', as 'tall' was mapped to increased height.
A superlative ranking a part within a set. The earlier review rejected 'broadest' on the same grounds.
Mostly 'connective not prolonged above the thecae', which means not excurrent. Statements that name the part it would pass are pattern 09.
'Hollowed abaxially' and 'deeply hollowed' describe a surface curving inward. PATO:0002078 hollow means an internal cavity, which is the sense only for trunks with cavities.
Rambling means long, loosely spreading, irregular growth and is paired with 'straggling' in the examples. That is FLOPO straggly, whose synonym is straggling.
A boss is a knob-like protuberance, often central. PATO umbonate is defined as having a knob or knob-like protuberance.

label: cruciform
definition: A shape quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being shaped like a cross, with four arms or parts spreading at right angles to one another.
reason: Used for corollas (Brassicaceae), lips and four-armed trichomes. PATO has no cross shape.

label: doubly toothed
definition: A dentated quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's marginal teeth themselves bearing smaller teeth.
reason: A standard leaf-margin character. PATO has dentated and serrated but no compound-toothed margin.
Not peltate is the negation of FLOPO peltate, as 'unlobed' is not lobed.
